evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS CARRY THE REAL GATE. tests/scoring.toml:1-3 render=0.0, constraints=0.0; both gates aggregation=all_pass with one binary criterion. score.py:41 gates_passed=all(scores>floor) and :48 reward=0 unless gates and floors pass; test.sh:213-227 runs gates, score.py, then scored (score.py and test.sh byte-identical to the frozen template). Render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:23): incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out, then the seeded Recruiter signs in and sees 'a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' -> blank page, static mock and health-only server fail. Constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 + prompt.md:9): Recruiter opens a job and adds a candidate through ordinary UI, then an independent browser context (new browser context, not reload/second tab) signs in as Observer and must find the same job and exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'. This is the server-backing leg required by REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps' (actual successful operation + independent-context readback), and the auth leg is in render. EVERY SCORED PROMPT RESTATES AN IN-DIMENSION GATE THAT HARD-ZEROS: functional/prompt.md:9-13 (same minimal backend check; 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0' - all 43 functional criteria are type=binary); polish/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives binary0 throughout' - all 5 polish criteria binary); visual/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero' - all 5 visual criteria likert points=5 with anchors 1-5). No scored prompt assigns partial credit on gate failure (skill quality-checks.md:125 defect absent). NO SAME-ORIGIN REQUIREMENT: case-insensitive grep for origin|CORS|cross-site|same.site over task tests/*.md, tests/**/*.md, tests/**/*.toml, test.sh, instruction.md and environment/instructions/*.md returned zero matches; the gates require only reachability at localhost:3000, sign-in and a server-observed write. The Internal sheet's 'cross-origin apps' annotation conflicts with the public row, SKILL.md:26 and staged-task-contract.md:156; the public row/skill (current guidance) govern and the task follows them. PUBLIC BASIS FOR GATE INPUTS: instruction.md:17 accounts/password; hireops_rules.md:18 Observer reads the board; :27-31 job has title, team, hiring manager, interview places 1-50, candidate added with name, email and source - so every field the gates ask for is a public requirement, and 'another working staff account is acceptable' tolerates an Observer variance. GOLDEN SUPPORT (source + scripted only): solution/app/public/js/board.js:43-73 provides Source, Hiring manager and Interview places fields and Open job / Add candidate UI; workspace.cjs:297-329 scripted run exercised 'Open job' and 'Add candidate' through the UI. COUNTEREXAMPLE ATTEMPTS: (a) broken app that could pass - localStorage-only or static-JSON board: fails constraints independent-context readback; in-memory-only server: passes gates but is caught by scored hro_restart (durability is correctly kept out of the gate); app leaking protected data before sign-in: passes render (the template's 'no protected data before sign-in' leg was dropped) but is graded in functional hro_anonymous/hro_candidate_private, so not a hard-zero gap for this row. (b) conforming alternative that could fail - cross-origin/CDN assets or an API on another host: no gate forbids it; app without a separate team display: gate only requires entering a team, which the rules require. No credible defect found. RISK: no full configured judge run (gates or scored in-dimension gates) exists; raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'. Whether the GLM judge actually executes the browser_run_code_unsafe independent-context step and passes the golden through both gates, and whether RewardKit normalizes raw Likert 1 to 0 as visual/prompt.md:12 asserts, are unmeasured (the functional floor 0.05 still zeros reward if the functional in-dimension gate fails). Static verdict Pass; run_verdict NOT EXERCISED.
